agc._note: Automatic gain control. Proven ineffective in testing, off by default, don't turn it back on. Comparison on the user's own 5 real recordings (407s): as-is 54 lines/541 chars; capture-side AGC on 43 lines/503 chars (worse, because it changes the signal the VAD sees); per-utterance normalization before recognition 54 lines/544 chars (same as as-is). Conclusion: SenseVoice is insensitive to level; quiet audio isn't solved by adjusting gain — switching models is (on the same recording whisper produced only 1 line, SenseVoice produced 3).

vad._note: Lowering the threshold from 0.5 to 0.35 is a measured result: in the user's two real recordings, 0.5 drops entire quiet sections — the 189s clip went 250 chars→268 chars, the 109s clip 112 chars→157 chars (+40%), and what's recovered is real speech, not noise. Going further down to 0.20 starts producing noise hallucinations like 'a Buddha's castle'. The console's 'pickup sensitivity' can be adjusted live.

asr._backend_note: whisper | sensevoice | funasr | zipformer. Measured RTF on this machine: whisper-small 0.47, sensevoice 0.047, zipformer 0.144. Default is sensevoice: 10x faster with fewer Chinese character errors. For word-by-word streaming output use zipformer (via stream_asr).

aliyun._note: Alibaba Cloud Bailian (DashScope) cloud recognition, two backends: aliyun_paraformer (model paraformer-realtime-v2, cheap Mandarin), aliyun_funasr (model fun-asr-realtime, recognizes dialects including Shanghainese and outputs Mandarin directly, no separate translation needed). The API key is read only from the DASHSCOPE_API_KEY environment variable, never written here or into git. The optional model field overrides the default model.

merge._note: Fragments cut out by endpoint detection (e.g. 'I.', 'so.') don't form their own line but merge into the next one — otherwise voiceprint would split one person into several speakers

asr._prompt_note: The prompt must be an actual classroom sentence with punctuation, used as an 'example' — it cannot be an instruction like 'please use Simplified Chinese'. The small model repeats instructions verbatim and, in testing, dropped 25% of the content. The example sentence should also avoid subject-specific words (e.g. 'formula'), or they leak into the transcript; put terms in hotwords instead.
asr.prompt: 嗯，好，那我们接着往下看啊。这个地方呢，是这样子的。
asr.hotwords: 极限 导数 偏导数 微分 不定积分 定积分 级数 傅里叶 泰勒 拉格朗日 洛必达 格林公式 高斯公式 斯托克斯 矩阵 行列式 特征值 二次型 动量守恒 角动量 刚体 麦克斯韦方程组 电磁感应 高斯定理 安培环路 薛定谔方程 光电效应

speaker._note: 阈值 0.60->0.35、模型 campplus->eres2netv2 都是实测结果：带标注的三人对话 44 句，原来 90.9% 准确但把 3 个人聚成 7 个（同一个人两句话的相似度常常只有 0.4 出头，够不到 0.6 就被判成新人）；改后 100% 准确、正好 3 个人。campplus 只在 0.30 这一个点上准，eres2netv2 在 0.20~0.40 一整片都准。幅度归一化试过，无效。

server._host_note: 0.0.0.0 = phones/tablets on the same WiFi can also use it (with require_token as the gate). To use it only on this machine, change to 127.0.0.1.
server._invite_note: If non-empty, registration requires entering this invite code correctly (give the code to the people who should join); leave empty = open registration. Changes here take effect immediately, no restart needed.
server._public_note: true = the service is exposed to the public internet (port forwarding/tunneling). In this case even the page itself requires a token, and scanners see only 401; 8 wrong token attempts lock the IP, with the lockout time doubling each time up to 6 hours; all access is logged to records/access.log. Keep false if only used on the LAN.
server._max_sessions_note: Maximum number of concurrent recording/transcription sessions. Sized for local CPU models (each session holds a recognition model in memory + CPU). When using the cloud (Aliyun) models recognition runs in the cloud, not on this machine, so you can raise this much higher; the real ceiling then becomes your DashScope concurrency quota.

deepseek._key_note: Enter your DeepSeek API key, or set the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable (higher priority). The key is used only on the server side, never sent to the browser. DeepSeek only has text models; speech recognition is still done locally.
